parsed.reason: The message has many strengths. It leads with a real, local, age-fitting program named on the venue's own page: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's Parent and Tot, 18 months to 3.11 years. It attributes with "their site says", has no link and no question, and uses the first-person watch promise correctly given watch=true. The price gap is phrased in the first person ("I could not pin down the price"), which is right under page_has_schedule. There are two problems. First, the pick list is empty even though a genuine find exists, so every date in the message appears nowhere in the picks. Second, "registration begins Oct 26" is attached in a way that reads as applying to the program generally. On the page it is the Winter 2027 registration date. A parent could wrongly conclude fall registration doesn't open until after the fall session has started, which is a material misstatement of the source.
